Dispatch.description:
Sends the job message of `attempt` when it is still the job's current attempt, not yet dispatched, while the
job is running. Sent by the run to itself, with a retry policy.
Dispatch.title: Dispatch

Failed.description:
The notification of a message to a watched actor that ended `failed`: what the failed message was and why it
failed. Its type name is `Failed`. A watcher's message family declares it as `Failed(cicada::Failed)`.

Its schema is part of every watcher's contract; a snapshot test pins it.

actor.description: The actor the failed message was for: the actor of the event, not the target of the watch.

attempts.description: How often the message was claimed: its `attempt`.

oneOf.description:
The handler returned an error or panicked, and no retry is left; or it returned a new state that cannot be
stored.

The node or the store failed around the turn: a read the node needed failed, also one the handler passed on,
or a panic outside the handler.
The handler refused the message for good (a permanent failure).
The turn ran past its maximum duration.
The message cannot be decoded.
The state or the address of the actor cannot be read by its type.
The effects of the turn were refused, or its commit was rejected or refused.
The message reached the claim limit (ADR 0025).

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the failed message; null when it has none.

from.description: The sender of the failed message; null for a message sent from outside a turn.

messageId.description: The id of the failed message.

messageType.description: The type name of the failed message.

payload.description: The payload of the failed message.

Failed.title: Failed

Report.description:
Sends the end report to the report target when the run has ended; on a running run it does nothing. The run
sends it itself in the commit that ends it; anyone may send it again, for a report that was lost or whose
target was gone, so a report target treats a repeated report for the same run as one.
Report.title: Report

oneOf.description: The job did its work.
The job did not do its work.

Result.description:
The result of one attempt of a job, from its worker or whoever the work was handed to: the sender is not
checked. Taken only when the job is `running` and `attempt` is its current attempt: the attempt ends with the
outcome and reason, the job takes the outcome and keeps `output`, and ready jobs start. Any other result is
refused for good with the reason and the state unchanged, so the store keeps it as a failed message of the run.

attempt.description: The attempt it reports, from the [`JobStart`].

output.description: What the job made, any JSON value of at most 16 KiB and 32 levels; absent or null: none.

reason.description: Why it ended so, at most 2,000 characters; absent or null: none.

Result.title: Result

Start.description:
Starts every ready job, in graph order, while fewer jobs run than the in-flight limit. Send it with the create,
in one commit; once nothing more can start it does nothing, so a second one is harmless.
Start.title: Start

Stopped.description:
The notification of a watched actor that went away. Its type name is `Stopped`. A watcher's message family declares
it as `Stopped(cicada::Stopped)`. Only a watch on the actor's own address tells of it.

Its schema is part of every watcher's contract; a snapshot test pins it.

by.description:
The actor whose turn removed it: the actor itself when it stopped, the stopping ancestor when it went with it;
null for a removal from outside a turn.

oneOf.description: Its own turn stopped it.
It was deleted from outside a turn.
It was removed with its parent (ADR 0019).

Stopped.title: Stopped

JobAttempt.description: One attempt of a job: the last one of a job is its current attempt.

dispatchedAt.description: The store time of the commit that sent its job message; null until then, and for good when that failed.

endedAt.description: The store time it ended; null while open.

outcome.description: How it ended; set exactly when it ended.

reason.description: Why it ended so, at most 2,000 characters; only on an ended attempt.

JobEntry.description: A job of a run: its definition, its status, its output and its attempts.

attempts.description:
Its attempts, oldest first, at most 20, numbered consecutively; the last is the current one and the only one
that may be open. Absent: none.

input.description: Its input: any JSON value of at most 16 KiB and 32 levels.

messageType.description:
The message type of its job message, whose payload is a [`JobStart`]; not empty, at most 200 characters,
without NUL.

name.description: Its name: 1 through 64 ASCII letters, digits, `-`, `_` or `.`, unique in the graph.

needs.description: The jobs that must succeed before it starts, each a job of the graph other than itself, named once.

output.description: The output of its last result; absent or null: none.

status.description: Its status, matching its last attempt; absent: `waiting`.

to.description: The target of its job message.

oneOf.description: A job runs or can start.
Ended: every job succeeded.
Ended: no job runs and none can start, and not every job succeeded.
Ended by a cancel; not set by this release.
The job did its work.
The job did not do its work.
Not started: some job it needs has not succeeded, or no room was free.
Its current attempt is open: dispatched or about to be.
Its last attempt succeeded.
Its last attempt failed; the jobs that need it do not start.
Not run, as a job it needs did not succeed; not set by this release.
Cancelled; not set by this release.

state.description:
The state of a [`JobGraph`] run: its graph, in-flight limit and report target, given at its create, its status, and
per job its status, output and attempts. Build it with `JobGraphState::new`; a decoded state is checked the same
way, so a bad graph never becomes a run.

On the wire: `{"maxInFlight":2,"reportTo":"ci/run-7","reportType":"GraphEnded","status":"running","endedAt":null,
"jobs":[{"name":"build","needs":[],"to":"builder/run-7","messageType":"Build","input":{},"status":"waiting",
"output":null,"attempts":[]}]}`; `status`, `endedAt` and a job's `status`, `output` and `attempts` may be left out
of a create.

endedAt.description: The store time it ended; set exactly when it ended. Absent: null.

jobs.description:
The jobs, in graph order, 1 through 100, without a cycle; at most `maxInFlight` run, and a started job's needs
all succeeded.

maxInFlight.description: The most jobs that run at once, dispatched or not; 1 through 100.

reportTo.description: The target of the end report.

reportType.description:
The message type of the end report, whose payload is a `JobGraphEnd`; not empty, at most 200 characters,
without NUL.

status.description:
The status of the run: ended exactly when no job runs and none can start, `succeeded` only when every job
succeeded. Absent: `running`.

state.title: JobGraphState
